import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.SectionRingUniversal
import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.DivisorModuleGeneratedSections

/-!
# A proper smooth curve is not affine

The global sections of a proper geometrically integral curve over a field form a
field, while relative dimension one supplies a point distinct from the generic
point.  Affineness would identify the curve with the spectrum of those global
sections, which is a subsingleton, giving the contradiction.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory Limits Opposite TopologicalSpace

namespace AlgebraicGeometry

theorem not_isAffine_of_smooth_proper_geometricallyIntegral_curve
    {k : Type u} [Field k] (C : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)))
    [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom] [IsProper C.hom]
    [GeometricallyIntegral C.hom] :
    ¬ IsAffine C.left := by
  intro hC
  letI : IsAffine C.left := hC
  letI : C.left.Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := .ofHom C.hom
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1
      (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) :=
    inferInstanceAs (SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 C.hom)
  letI : IsIntegral C.left :=
    Scheme.isIntegral_left_of_geometricallyIntegral C
  letI : Field Γ(C.left, ⊤) := (Scheme.isField_globalSections C).toField
  haveI : Subsingleton (Spec (CommRingCat.of Γ(C.left, ⊤))) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (PrimeSpectrum Γ(C.left, ⊤)))
  haveI : Subsingleton ((Scheme.forgetToTop.obj (Spec (CommRingCat.of Γ(C.left, ⊤))): TopCat) : Type _) :=
    inferInstanceAs (Subsingleton (PrimeSpectrum Γ(C.left, ⊤)))
  letI : SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 (C.left ↘ Spec (CommRingCat.of k)) := inferInstance
  haveI : Subsingleton ((Scheme.forgetToTop.obj C.left : TopCat) : Type _) :=
    ((TopCat.homeoOfIso (Scheme.forgetToTop.mapIso C.left.isoSpec)).toEquiv).subsingleton
  obtain ⟨z, hz⟩ := Scheme.exists_ne_genericPoint_of_smoothCurve k (X := C.left)
  exact hz (Subsingleton.elim z (genericPoint C.left))

end AlgebraicGeometry
